facts.text: Itz'ana is a beachfront and marina resort in Placencia, Belize.
facts.excerpt: Discover Itz’ana Resort & Residences, a luxury beachfront and marina resort in Placencia, Belize.

facts.text: The resort's address is Mile 20 Placencia Road, Placencia, Stann Creek District, Belize.
facts.excerpt: Mile 20 Placencia Road, Placencia, Stann Creek District, Belize

facts.text: The resort sits on a white-sand beach on the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Sink into the soft sand of a pristine white-sand beach.

facts.text: The beach villas have multiple bedrooms, full kitchens, decks, plunge pools and Caribbean views.
facts.excerpt: Live and entertain luxuriously in chic, multi-bedroom villas with kitchens, decks, plunge pools, and idyllic Caribbean views.

facts.text: Villa and penthouse interiors are designed by Samuel Amoia.
facts.excerpt: Interior design by Samuel Amoia

facts.text: The One Bedroom Beachfront Villa has an outdoor bathtub and rainforest shower.
facts.excerpt: Outdoor bathtub and rainforest shower

facts.text: The Two Bedroom Beach Villa has a plunge pool on its beachfront deck and an atrium garden with an indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Relax in the plunge pool on your beachfront deck or escape to the atrium garden with an indoor pool.

facts.text: The penthouses sit above the resort with expansive terraces, private plunge pools and views across the resort and Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: our two- and three-bedroom penthouses bring together generous indoor and outdoor living, expansive terraces, private plunge pools, and views across the resort and Caribbean Sea

facts.text: Marina Villas each have a private plunge pool, and the One-Bedroom Marina Villa has a waterfront deck and dedicated boat dock.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a private plunge pool, waterfront deck, and dedicated boat dock

facts.text: The full-service marina has a watersports activity center, refueling station and supplies store.
facts.excerpt: Our full - service marina features a watersports activity center, refueling station, and supplies store.

facts.text: The marina is on the calm lagoon waters of Placencia.
facts.excerpt: Itz’ana Marina is located along the calm lagoon waters of Placencia, Belize

facts.text: Coral Caye is the resort's private island off the coast of Placencia.
facts.excerpt: Escape to Coral Caye, Itz’ana’s private island off the coast of Placencia.

facts.text: Coral Caye is a two-acre private island with ocean-view cottages, a thatched dining pavilion and a dedicated island team.
facts.excerpt: Coral Caye is a serene two-acre private island escape off the coast of Belize, offering barefoot comfort, ocean-view cottages, a thatched dining pavilion, and a dedicated island team.

facts.text: Coral Caye is off-grid and solar-powered.
facts.excerpt: Off-grid and solar-powered, it is ideal for families or adults seeking privacy, peace, and total disconnection.

facts.text: Coral Caye is available for day trips, private island picnics, overnight stays and curated experiences.
facts.excerpt: Available for day trips, private island picnics, overnight stays, and curated experiences

facts.text: Guided yoga, breathwork and movement sessions take place along the Caribbean shoreline.
facts.excerpt: Reconnect body and mind with guided yoga, breathwork, and movement sessions set directly along the Caribbean shoreline.

facts.text: Spa treatments can be arranged in the guest's suite or villa.
facts.excerpt: unwind with a personalized spa treatment in the comfort of your suite or villa

facts.text: Private meditation and sound healing sessions are available on request.
facts.excerpt: Reconnect with yourself through private meditation and sound healing sessions

facts.text: Limilia Restaurant serves seasonal, seafood-forward cuisine using produce from the resort's organic farm and fish line-caught by its own fisherman.
facts.excerpt: Seasonal, seafood-forward cuisine highlights locally sourced ingredients, including vegetables and herbs from our organic farm and fresh fish line-caught by our own fisherman.

facts.text: Biblio Bar is in The Great House, with leather chairs, bookcases and a speakeasy hidden in the library walls.
facts.excerpt: Discover our speakeasy hidden among the walls of the library

facts.text: Resort experiences include rum and beer tastings, chocolate workshops, Garifuna cooking, hair braiding and drumming lessons.
facts.excerpt: Through rum and beer tastings, chocolate workshops, Garifuna cooking, hair braiding, and drumming lessons

facts.text: The Belize Barrier Reef is about 14 miles offshore, a 40-minute boat ride to the dive site.
facts.excerpt: Explore Belize's Grand Channel with a trip to the Belize Barrier Reef, only 14 miles offshore. After a 40-minute boat ride to your dive site

facts.text: Laughing Bird Caye national park is 11 miles off the coast of Placencia.
facts.excerpt: Just 11 miles off the coast of Placencia, this little national park packs a lot of paradise in

facts.text: Ka'ana Resort in San Ignacio is Itz'ana's sister property inland.
facts.excerpt: Discover Ka’ana Resort, Itz’ana’s sister property in San Ignacio, Belize.

facts.text: Penthouses and villas are suited to families and groups, with full kitchens and multiple bedrooms.
facts.excerpt: Ideal for families and friends seeking privacy, comfort, and room to reconnect on Belize’s Caribbean coast.

facts.text: Advance reservations are recommended for private tours, sea excursions and guided cultural experiences.
facts.excerpt: Advance reservations are recommended, especially for private tours, sea excursions, guided cultural experiences, and seasonal activities.

facts.text: Guests arriving by private boat or yacht can reserve a slip at Itz'ana Marina.
facts.excerpt: Designed for guests arriving by private boat or yacht, our marina offers a seamless arrival point

facts.text: Villa services include private chef experiences, in-villa dining, spa treatments, grocery pre-stocking, laundry and family support.
facts.excerpt: From private chef experiences and in-villa dining to spa treatments, grocery pre-stocking, laundry service, and family support

facts.text: The resort has an infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: refreshing swims in the infinity pool
